preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is the current Chair.
The target member is in the room with an unmuted microphone; LiveKit is configured.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Chair; target: the member identity.
cases.return: Success; that microphone track is muted. Only muting, never unmuting: nobody gets their microphone switched on by someone else.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is the current Chair.
The target member is in the room and already muted.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Chair; target: the member identity.
cases.return: Success; the provider is not called again for an already-muted microphone.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a current Member (not the Chair).
The target is in the room with a microphone.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Member; target: another member identity.
cases.return: NotChair; 403 "Chỉ chủ toạ mới tắt được micro của người khác." (MSG123).

preconditions: Caller has no room access for the meeting (unknown user).
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the stranger; target: a member identity.

preconditions: Meeting Published with mode Online; caller is the current Chair.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Chair; target: a member identity.
cases.return: RoomNotOpen; 409 "Phòng họp chỉ mở khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra." (MSG117).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode InPerson; caller is the current Chair.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Chair; target: a member identity.
cases.return: RoomNotOpen (MSG117); an in-person sitting has no room to mute in.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is the current Chair.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Chair; target: a member identity.
cases.return: NotConfigured; 503 "Phòng họp trực tuyến chưa sẵn sàng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." (MSG281).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is the current Chair.
LiveKit is configured but the target is not in the room (or has no microphone track).
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Chair; target: that identity.
cases.return: TargetNotInRoom; 409 "Người này không còn trong phòng hoặc chưa bật micro." (MSG282).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is the current Chair; the target has a microphone.
The provider refuses the mute call.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Chair; target: the member identity.
cases.return: ProviderFailed; 502 "Máy chủ phòng họp không phản hồi. Vui lòng thử lại." (MSG124).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is the current Chair.
The access read fails in storage.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Chair; target: a member identity.
cases.return: ReadFailed; 500 "Không thể tắt micro. Vui lòng thử lại." (MSG284).
cases.log: Could not read call room access for meeting {MeetingId}.
